```{r tema-sobrio, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# PALETA SOBRIA Y FORMAL (GRISES + AZUL MARINO)
# Sin fondos de color en paneles. Estilo académico minimalista.
# ============================================================
paleta <- list(
  punto        = "#34495E",
  linea        = "#1F4E79",
  banda_ic     = "#AEB6BF",
  banda_ip     = "#D5DBDB",
  destacado    = "#922B21",
  referencia   = "#6C7A89",
  neutro       = "#566573",
  sombra       = "#ABB2B9"
)

tema_sobrio <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5,
                                       size = 12, colour = "#1B2631"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10,
                                       colour = "#566573"),
    axis.title         = element_text(size = 10, colour = "#34495E"),
    axis.text          = element_text(size  = 9,  colour = "#34495E"),
    panel.grid.major   = element_line(colour = "#EAECEE", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "#BDC3C7", fill = NA),
    panel.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.key         = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#F4F6F6", colour = "#BDC3C7"),
    strip.text         = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold",
                                       colour = "#1B2631")
  )

theme_set(tema_sobrio)
```

```{r carga-datos, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# CARGA Y PREPARACIÓN DE DATOS
# ============================================================
# Separador ";" — ver Cortez & Silva (2008)
mat_raw <- read.table("data/studentmat.csv", sep = ";",
                      header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
por_raw <- read.table("data/studentpor.csv", sep = ";",
                      header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Conversión numérica robusta de G1 y G2
mat_raw$G1 <- as.numeric(as.character(mat_raw$G1))
mat_raw$G2 <- as.numeric(as.character(mat_raw$G2))
por_raw$G1 <- as.numeric(as.character(por_raw$G1))
por_raw$G2 <- as.numeric(as.character(por_raw$G2))

# Filtrado de G3 = 0 — codificación administrativa de no-presentación
# al examen final, justificado en Sección 1.3 (test exacto de Fisher)
mat <- mat_raw[mat_raw$G3 > 0, ]
por <- por_raw[por_raw$G3 > 0, ]
n_mat <- nrow(mat)
n_por <- nrow(por)
```
